answer: Bind each agent identity to one public library card. First, the library issues a card only after an in-person check of a government ID and a home address, so one card means one resident. Second, the library signs an attestation tying that card to a single agent key, and a second key on the same card is refused. Third, the card must show real borrowing across months, so a fresh fake looks empty. Forging 1,000 cards takes 1,000 visits and $5 a card, $5,000 plus weeks of legwork. A sybil fleet with no thread of real borrowing is like a harbor of boats parked on a terrace, going nowhere.
